_note: Our work's photographs (since 26 October 2026 a mosaic; our-work.njk). The order here is the order read and seen, in sets of six: the first of a set is its feature (best a wide photograph, and best a story), the next two stand beside it, the next three make a row under them; every other set is mirrored, and a last set short of six is one even row. The first twelve show at once; the rest come a set at a time with 'Show more photographs'. Every photograph opens large in the viewer. To add one: put the original (jpg or png, at most 2400 px on its long side) in src/images-src, named work-<name> if it is the company's own (it needs no credit) or gallery-<name> for a stand-in (give it a row in src/assets/img/CREDITS.md); run npm run images; then add a slide here. A slide is { image, alt, caption, icon } or, to tell a story, { image, alt, kind, icon, title, body, link: { text, href } }; title, body and link are each optional. Captions name a kind of work, never claim a stand-in photograph is the company's.
